name: The Founders (Anua)
corridor_involvement: Present in India but not landed. Anua is listed on Amazon India (corridor.yaml conduits) and its Heartleaf 77% Soothing Toner 250ml is priced at Rs2,050 list on Nykaa (sale Rs1,743) with Amazon showing a different MRP of Rs2,999 — MRP varies by platform, itself a sign of an uncontrolled route to market. On the Blinkit capture (2026-07-23) all three Anua SKUs at Rs1,650-2,000 read 'Coming Soon'. No launch event or platform partnership is recorded.
read: A KRW 228.5bn producer growing 50% a year (MFDS, MEDIUM) and one of the brands driving the K-beauty narrative — yet in India it is the clearest example of narrative outrunning distribution. Its hero SKU is listed but not stocked on q-commerce, and its MRP differs by platform, which means the brand is arriving through unmanaged channel supply rather than a principal-led entry. That gap is the corridor whitespace stated plainly: the indie derma brands consumers are asking for are precisely the ones absent from the access rail, while conglomerate brands occupy it.
